_note: Reviewed exceptions for the FreshContext Trust Scanner.
Every entry names a rule, a file, and why that match is expected there. The schema requires a
reason, which is the point: an allowlist without reasons is just a way to stop looking.
Triaged 2026-09-13 against a full scan of 130 findings. None were genuine stale public claims.
Entries are rule+file scoped; the scanner does not support line scoping. For the auth-code
entries that means a future real key in those files would be suppressed by this rule --
GitGuardian runs in CI and is the actual secret scanner for that case.
